purpose: Put one real customer's face, quote, name and role at full width so a visitor sees a peer vouching for a specific outcome. One layout, implemented three times in the source (home, /startups, product pages).

behaviour.note: Shared layout: square portrait (700x700) on the left, large quote on the right over a coloured card backdrop, and a white name tag bar (h-14) overlapping the bottom of the photo. Below md the name tag overlaps the photo with a negative top margin; from md it sits bottom-left of the photo (self-end).

Three real implementations of one layout (duplicated code to consolidate): a home-only component, a configurable component used by /startups, and a product-page component fed from product data. Modelled here as three variants.
Product pages place this section between two accordions (find, connect), between an accordion and the FAQ (sell) and between the cards and an accordion (manage). Not present on foundation.
Card colour on product pages is chosen per product in data: find pink-2, connect teal-2, sell teal-2, manage pink-3. /startups defaults to teal-2 (#c9f8ff).
The role line may contain a link to the customer's company (startups variant) or non-breaking-space markup (product variant).

variants.name: home-dark-card
variants.description: Home. gray-3 section band, gray-10 (dark) card, only a top neutral pattern strip, light quote text (gray-2). Hard-wired quote, photo and name; not configurable.

variants.name: startups-colored-card
variants.description: /startups. Configurable component: gray-9 section band, coloured card (default teal-2 #c9f8ff), dark quote text (#121212), top and bottom pattern strips, lazy photo, role may carry a link.

variants.name: product-colored-card
variants.description: Product pages (find, connect, sell, manage). gray-9 band, card colour supplied by product data (Tailwind bg class), gray-10 quote text, top and bottom pattern strips, quote and role as inline HTML strings.

photo.note: Square portrait of the real customer quoted. Existing real file only; never generate, edit or substitute.

photoAlt.note: Observed as the first name plus the word photo.

quote.note: Observed: home 72, startups 55, products 40 to 48. Real customer words; never fabricate.

role.note: Title, company. Observed up to 6 words; may include a link (startups variant).

cardColor.note: Coloured card behind the photo and quote. Ignored by home-dark-card (fixed gray-10). Values are the ones used in source; QuoteTestimonial default is teal-2.

sectionBackground.note: home-dark-card uses gray-3; the two coloured variants use gray-9 by default.

patternStrips.note: Top strip (all variants; neutral on home) and bottom strip (coloured variants only).

motion.reducedMotionNote: No motion in the source, so no fallback is needed; no prefers-reduced-motion handling exists in the code.
